\caption{Single-grain apatite (U--Th)/He data for the Montreal River monocline, listed by sample group. The reduced data are archived as data/UTh\_He\_apatite\_data.csv in the project repository; the underlying laboratory report files are archived in the \texttt{projects\_2023/TA23\_MRM\_MCR} directory of the \texttt{wrguenthner/HAL\_data} repository. Mass is the aliquot mass from the measured grain dimensions, $R$ is the grain radius used in the $\alpha$-ejection correction and in the diffusion calculations, and $F_T$ is the $\alpha$-ejection correction. He, U, Th, and Sm amounts are followed in parentheses by their 1$\sigma$ analytical uncertainties expressed as a percentage of the amount. Concentrations are calculated from these amounts and the aliquot mass, and eU~=~[U]~+~0.235[Th]. ``Raw date'' is the date before the $\alpha$-ejection correction and ``corrected date'' is the date after it; both are given with the 1$\sigma$ uncertainties returned by the laboratory data reduction, which propagate analytical uncertainties only and do not include uncertainty in $F_T$ or dispersion between grains. The Durango apatite aliquots were not measured for grain dimensions, so mass, $R$, and concentrations are not reported for them and $F_T$ is set to unity. Superscript symbols in the ``Notes'' column are defined beneath the table. The Durango apatite aliquots reported here give a mean date of 35.0~Ma with a standard deviation of 4.9~Ma ($n$~=~4).}\label{tab:apatite_UThHe} \\
